description: Delivery workflow gates: run preflight (tests, lint, typecheck, secrets, review routing) when Claude finishes a turn that edited files; scan commits for secrets; ask before pushes, tags, merges, releases and deploys. With an autonomy policy in .claude/delivery.json (v3), the approved steps (review, push feature branches, open PRs, turn on Auto-fix, clean up merged branches, continue the backlog) run without asking; since v3.2 the hooks approve them outright, so auto mode's classifier doesn't stop them either. Skipped, with one notice at session start, when bun is missing.
